lines.trans: Hello again! I wanted to apologize for today.
Everything is my fault.
Oh, stop it, you didn't do it on purpose!
Maybe it's for the best. Everything was falling apart for a long time.

words.gloss: for (in к лучшему = for the best)
the best (к лучшему = for the best)

lines.trans: You deserve the very best! I have something for you.

words.gram: substantivized neuter singular genitive after достойны

lines.trans: Please take it! My grandfather gave this brooch to my grandmother.
Very beautiful! What if you meet someone else?
I already have met her! But she rejects my advances.
A blue flame flickered! For the first time I sang of love!
Marina, that's the phone. Please turn it off!
Oh, it's Ilona! I'll put it on speaker.
Arkady Borisovich, why do you need those fake casts on your arms?
Ilona, what nonsense are you saying? Marina, I'll explain everything!
Marina, listen, it's all because of love!
So, you're a faker? Does it hurt right now?

examples.trans: My grandmother lives in the village.
That's better than the old lady.

examples.text: Эту брошь подарил мой дедушка моей бабушке.
examples.trans: My grandfather gave this brooch to my grandmother.

examples.text: На пальто у неё была красивая брошь.
examples.trans: She had a beautiful brooch on her coat.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
present есть; у меня есть = I have

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: in questions: а вдруг...? = and what if...?

examples.text: А вдруг вы ещё кого-нибудь встретите?
examples.trans: What if you meet someone else?

meanings.note: 'взять на работу' = to give someone a job
short forms виноват / виновата / виноваты are used for 'it's my/your fault'

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

meanings.en: to meet, to pick up (at a station)

examples.text: Меня никто не встретил на вокзале.
examples.trans: Nobody met me at the station.
I will meet you at the entrance.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

выйти.gloss: to go out, to get out

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда через две недели.
examples.trans: I'll be out of here in two weeks.

meanings.note: наложить/снять гипс = to put on / take off a cast

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, зачем вам этот ложный гипс на руках?
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, why do you need those fake casts on your arms?

examples.text: Врач снял гипс с его руки.
examples.trans: The doctor removed the cast from his arm.

meanings.note: distinct in Russian from синий (dark/royal blue)

examples.text: Над городом было чистое голубое небо.
examples.trans: Above the town was a clear light-blue sky.

meanings.note: поставить громко = to put a phone on speaker

examples.text: Не говорите так громко, дети спят.
examples.trans: Don't speak so loudly, the children are asleep.

давно.gloss: for a long time; long ago

meanings.note: with present: Я давно здесь = I've been here a long time

examples.trans: You haven't been interested in me for a long time.

meanings.note: masculine noun that declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.text: Эту брошь подарил мой дедушка моей бабушке.
examples.trans: My grandfather gave this brooch to my grandmother.
My grandfather lives in the countryside.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: достойная старость = a comfortable, dignified old age

examples.text: А мы обеспечим вам достойную старость.
examples.trans: And we will ensure you a comfortable old age.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

заметаться.gloss: to begin tossing about, flicker wildly

meanings.en: to start darting or flickering about
meanings.note: in Yesenin's poem: заметался пожар голубой = a blue flame flickered

examples.trans: The bird began darting about the cage in fright.

запеть.gloss: to begin to sing, break into song

meanings.note: prefix за- marks the beginning of an action

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Весной в саду громко запели птицы.
examples.trans: In spring the birds began singing loudly in the garden.

meanings.note: polite, or to several people; the first в is silent
что это значит? = what does this mean?
the form значит is used as a linking word

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!
examples.trans: Because of your Lyolya the whole class calls me a little liar!
We were late because of the rain.
There's someone here to see you.
I want to show you something.
They have a very beautiful house.
Somebody on the street will tell him.

meanings.note: ложный вызов = false alarm; ложный гипс = fake cast

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, зачем вам этот ложный гипс на руках?
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, why do you need those fake casts on your arms?

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world
fleeting vowel о drops in genitive/dative/prepositional (любви), kept in instrumental (любовью)

examples.text: Первый раз я запел про любовь!
examples.trans: For the first time I sang of love!

examples.text: Марина, послушайте, это всё из-за любви!
examples.trans: Marina, listen, it's all because of love!
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: Russian uses one word for both
hesitation, at the start of a sentence

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: отвергать ухаживания / предложение = to reject advances / an offer

отключить.gloss: to switch off, to cut off

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

meanings.note: с первого раза = the first time

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

meanings.note: начался пожар = a fire broke out

examples.trans: The firefighters quickly put out the fire.
Put your foot on the bed.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

meanings.note: of an old object, relationship, or business

examples.trans: Everything was falling apart for a long time.
The old chair is completely falling apart.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми
forms the superlative: самый главный = the most important

examples.trans: The most important thing is the people.

meanings.note: someone who fakes an illness or injury
не специально = not on purpose, by accident

examples.text: Ну перестаньте, вы же не специально!
examples.trans: Oh, stop it, you didn't do it on purpose!

examples.text: Я приготовил этот торт специально для вас.
examples.trans: I made this cake specially for you.

meanings.note: ordinal numeral: в третьем поколении = third-generation

examples.trans: He lives on the third floor.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
